meta.name: browser-debugging
meta.description: Debug client-side issues using browser developer tools. Identify JavaScript errors, styling issues, and performance problems in the browser.

copy.tagline: 用浏览器开发者工具定位并修复前端问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在浏览器中排查 JavaScript 错误、样式或性能问题
copy.tagline_en: Debug client-side issues using browser developer tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to identify JavaScript errors, styling issues, or performance problems in the browser

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能使用Chrome开发者工具的功能，比如检查网页元素、查看JavaScript错误、监控网络请求等，帮你诊断和修复浏览器端的问题。
howto.when: 当你遇到网页上的JavaScript错误、样式问题、性能问题，或者要求调试浏览器端问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这个页面的JavaScript错误。
这个网页加载很慢，能帮我看看原因吗？
这个按钮的CSS样式为什么没生效？

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can use Chrome DevTools features like inspecting elements, viewing JavaScript errors, monitoring network requests, etc., to help diagnose and fix browser-side issues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you encounter JavaScript errors, styling issues, performance problems on a webpage, or ask to debug browser-side issues.

say_en.text: Check the JavaScript errors on this page.
say_en.note: Claude will open the Console tab to view errors.

say_en.text: This page loads slowly, can you help me find out why?
say_en.note: Claude will use the Network tab to analyze requests.

say_en.text: Why isn't this button's CSS styling working?
say_en.note: Claude will inspect the Elements tab for styles.
